sources.raytheon: https://frank.pocnet.net/sheets/138/5/5725.pdf (Raytheon 5725/6AS6W, 15 Dec 1960), pages 8-11; data/raytheon_5725_p8-11.csv and (p.8 bottom Ib, issue #51) data/raytheon_5725_p8bottom.csv

split_check: held out: Raytheon Ic2 vs Ec3 (p.10 bottom, p.11 top dashed curves) are in no fit

dual_control.fit: issue #51: Raytheon p.8-11 except the held-out Ic2-vs-Ec3 curves, plus the p.8 bottom Ib curves (weight 1.0 per point); residual ln((I_model + I0)/(I_data + I0)), I0 = 0.02 mA

refit_25.fit: issue #25: Raytheon p.8-11 except the held-out Ic2-vs-Ec3 curves (no p.8 bottom); same residual

sensitivity_p8_weight_0_25.fit: as dual_control, but weight 0.25 per p.8 bottom point

before.fit: GE p.3 + p.4 (Ec2 = 120 V); residual (model - data)/max(data, 0.3 mA)

ablation_raytheon_relative_residual.fit: same Raytheon data as dual_control, BEFORE's residual (model - data)/max(data, 0.3 mA)

raytheon_internal_consistency.point: Ib at Eb = Ec2 = 120 V, Ec1 = -2 V, Ec3 = 0
Ib at Eb = Ec2 = 120 V, Ec1 = -4 V, Ec3 = 0
Ic2 at Eb = Ec2 = 120 V, Ec1 = -2 V, Ec3 = 0
Ic2 at Eb = Ec2 = 120 V, Ec1 = -4 V, Ec3 = 0

koren.note: GE p.3 baseline only; g3 is not an input, so it cannot represent any suppressor data
